summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Collective Mining Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its annual and special meeting of shareholders held on June 15, 2026. The filing discloses the election of five director nominees as listed in the management information circular. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or going-private transaction is involved. All nominees were elected with overwhelming shareholder support. The filing is a routine periodic report and does not constitute a special-situation event.
